just: one command for every task in a project

The problem it solves

Every project has a handful of commands: run the checks, run the tests, start the app, build the docs. Each one has flags and an order, and three months later nobody (including me) remembers them. The same task is called something different in every repository, and a coding agent working in the project has to guess.

The general idea

just is a command runner. A file called Justfile holds named recipes, and just name runs one. It looks like make without the build-system baggage. If every project uses the same names, my fingers do not need to know which project I am in, and the Justfile documents how things are run, for me and for agents.

Examples

A typical project Justfile:

default:
    @just --list

check:
    ruff check --fix
    ruff format
    pyright

test:
    uv run pytest

run *args:
    uv run python -m project {{args}}

Recipes take arguments with default values, which turns small scripts into tools. A recipe of mine that sends a file to another computer is declared as push force="false", and just push force=true overrides its safety check.

Tips from my setup

  • A global Justfile for what I do everywhere. just -g runs recipes from a Justfile in my dotfiles, organised in modules, one file per topic: 
    mod git    "~/dotfiles/just/git.just"
mod watch  "~/dotfiles/just/watch.just"
mod scp    "~/dotfiles/just/scp.just"
mod vpn    "~/dotfiles/just/vpn.just"
  • Recipes that move files. just -g scp push asks which of my computers I mean, lets me pick the file with a fuzzy finder and copies it over.
  • [no-cd] for global recipes. The attribute keeps a recipe in the directory I called it from, instead of jumping to the Justfile's folder.
  • Launchers for coding agents. A recipe starts the agent with a strict policy, for example one that must show a diff and wait for my approval before touching a file. One word instead of a flag I would forget.
  • Find recipes with a fuzzy finder. A television channel lists the recipes of the local and the global Justfile with a preview of each and runs the chosen one with a key. See the post about tv.
